name: openssl
description: General purpose TLS and crypto library
one_liner: The security plumbing that makes most of the internet's 'https' padlock actually work.
buyer: Hard to find a direct buyer — it's invisible infrastructure almost nobody pays for directly; the real market is companies needing compliance help.
business_use_cases: A security consultancy audits a client's certificate management and version hygiene for regulated industries, billed as a compliance project.
A managed-PKI provider builds certificate-lifecycle-management services on top of it for companies that don't want to manage TLS certs themselves.

money_ideas.idea: Compliance and security audit service around a company's TLS and certificate setup
Managed certificate lifecycle service for companies without security staff

steal_this: Honestly, there's no product to sell here directly — the only real business is being the security consultant who audits and fixes a company's TLS setup.
